_comment_default_working_dir: DEFAULT_WORKING_DIR is NOT here on purpose. Settings reads it from .env only (src/config.py), so a copy in this file would be read by nothing and would disagree with the real value the moment either changed. Copy .env.example to .env and set it there. See README, Path B.
_comment_agents: Launch commands are wrappers, one default per family (claude, codex, hermes, openclaw, local, shell). Leave the list empty: first boot seeds each family's standard wrapper, and you edit them on the wrappers page.
_comment_message_archive: RETIRED AND LOCKED OFF (#1660). The byte-exact message archive cannot be turned on: this key and the CLOUDE_MESSAGE_ARCHIVE environment variable are ignored, and a set one logs a single warning at startup. Existing message_* tables and cloude-archive.db are left untouched.
_comment_common_slash_commands: Bare strings still work exactly as before; their short descriptions come from the built-in table in src/core/slash_command_labels.py. Use the object form only to override the wording or to describe a command the table does not know. Keep descriptions under 28 characters - they render on the chip on a phone.
_comment_projects_retired: PROJECTS ARE NOT A CONFIG CONCERN ANY MORE. They live in cloude.db's projects table and nowhere else. This file used to carry a projects array plus a comment documenting its shape; keeping that documentation now would be a stale doc, which is worse than no doc because a reader would act on it and then wonder why nothing appeared. Add projects from the app (the + control on the launchpad). An upgrading install that still has a projects key loses nothing: the app imports every entry the database has never seen, re-reads the table to prove it covers the file, and only then removes the key.
_comment_workspace: Global settings for what a NEW terminal is born with. Edited from the web app's settings screen (gear icon -> workspace), not by hand: the running server caches this file and only re-reads it when it writes it itself, so a hand edit needs a restart. Every value defaults to empty, which means 'not configured' - development_root reaches terminals as CLOUDE_DEV_ROOT, default_shell as SHELL, and env is injected verbatim. Names beginning CLOUDECODE_ are reserved by the app and refused.
_comment_ui: CLIENT-SIDE SHOW/HIDE SWITCHES, ALL DEFAULT-ON. Every flag here turns OFF a control that ships, so an absent block, an absent key and an unparseable block all mean the same thing: show everything. show_mark_unread_control is the manual 'mark this session unread for followup' toggle on the sidebar row and the launchpad card. It is NOT the unread indicator - the status LED's still green ring is what says a session is unread, and that is not optional. Unread tracking is unaffected either way. Reported live at GET /api/v1/features and editable from the settings screen.
_comment_server_prefs: Bind address and TLS preference, remembered across restarts so they do not have to be re-picked from the menu bar. bind_host is a PREFERENCE: the address actually bound is resolved by src/core/setup_state.py, which pins loopback until an authenticator has been paired, and uvicorn binds once so a change applies on the next restart. tls_preferred is recorded and NOT in force - this build serves plain HTTP and has no TLS terminator.
